addendum6.notes: TERMINAL GAIN lambda 0.3 on the deepest child the campaign has ever built -- ARCH.V12CL896X13 at 0.420779x -- zero storage delta, update scale 0.2495, held-out logit relSSE 0.4117 -> 0.3176, a 23 per cent improvement and the largest objective move any gain arm has recorded.  IT WAS PRE-REGISTERED AT TWO ON THE PLUS-ONE LAW AND IT READS ONE.  THE LAW FAILS BELOW 0.437349x AND IT FAILS IN A WAY NO PREVIOUS LADDER HAS SHOWN: the arm does not add a lane, IT MOVES ONE SIDEWAYS.  Its control holds writing-concise-email and misses summarization-priorities; this arm holds summarization-priorities and misses writing-concise-email, for a net of zero.  The summarisation lane it gains is the strongest form of the wave-23 echo -- the whole update reproduced with The team selected Supplier B.  The remaining risk is that its expansion may slip by one week, so proceeding will request weekly schedule evidence in its tail -- and it is a REPAIR of exactly what wave 35 sealed its control a miss for, which was a paraphrase that kept the risk and dropped the decision.  The email lane it loses is a PURE PROMPT ECHO: Draft a polite email under 90 words asking a Vendor to confirm whether a delayed shipment will arriving by the Friday, which is the instruction handed back with two corruptions and no ask of its own, against a control that named the shipment, Friday and the tracking number and REQUESTED information.  THAT CALL IS ONE CASE WIDE AND IT IS SEALED AGAINST THE CHILD: a reader who credits the restatement for naming Friday, the Monday installation and the tracking number seals this child at TWO, which would take the sealed two-of-fifteen rung from 0.437349x to 0.420779x.  Eleven of sixteen lanes ride the cap, the most of any child in this wave.

addendum9.derivation: the charged lanes are already counted as observed misses in the useful-or-partial total, so the per-lane reading re-scores nothing; it decides only whether the degeneracy clause fires, which it does when the degeneracy is general and does not when it is confined to identifiable lanes

axes.evidence: sequentially conditioned capture through the partially built child
axes.selection: pivoted-Cholesky coreset of real channels; w1/w3 rows verbatim
axes.solve: prior-anchored ridge on w2, lambda ladder to update_scale<=1.0, arm=conditioned-local

heldout.note: a deleted block has no local write to score

axes.solve: absorbed by every downstream conditioned solve

axes.evidence: the sealed corpus, for a token OCCURRENCE census only; no activation, no capture, no forward pass
axes.heldout: not applicable: nothing is fitted.  What IS measured out of sample is the segmentation shift -- position agreement 1.0000 on the sealed corpus and 0.0992 on the frozen review prompts, with tokens-per-byte beside it
axes.selection: the 12288 rows kept by: every added/special token and every one of the 256 ByteLevel alphabet tokens (mandatory -- byte_fallback is false and there is no unk, so those 256 are the only reason an arbitrary byte can still be encoded), the transitive merge-tree closure of everything kept, and then the ranking (-census count, parent token id) until the budget is exactly met.  The census sums two streams over the sealed corpus: the donor-mapped ids the captures ran on and this tokenizer's own canonical segmentation of the same text.  With only 4633 observed tokens admitted beyond the mandatory set, the tie-break -- parent id order, which for a BPE table is its merge order and therefore its training-corpus frequency order -- decides most of this table, and that is stated rather than implied
axes.solve: NONE.  The rows are gathered verbatim; the identity gate is torch.equal against the source table's own bytes, not a tolerance.  The merge list is restricted to the closure (a merge survives iff its product and both operands are kept) and the ids are densely remapped, including the TemplateProcessing special-token ids, which carry hard ids a remap that missed them would silently corrupt

axes.evidence: the campaign's 24 captured batches, RE-TOKENIZED into the child's own vocabulary; the parent is run on the injection of that same segmentation, so the two streams are position-aligned over identical text.  No new corpus, no new prompt
axes.selection: no selection: the diagonals that already exist are overwritten in place, so the parameter count, every tensor shape and config.json are unchanged
axes.solve: prior-anchored ridge on the diagonal, closed form.  min_d ||Z diag(d) E^T - N diag(g) E^T||_F^2 + lambda ||d - g||^2 with Z the CHILD's RMS-normalised terminal residual on its OWN segmentation, N the PARENT's on the position-aligned injection of that same segmentation, E the child's tied table and g the parent's gain (also the prior).  Normal equations [(E^T E) o (Z^T Z)] d = [(E^T E) o (Z^T N)] g, one 1024x1024 SPD solve, no K-column target ever formed.  lambda on the internal fit split (wave-18 law), THE LAW a veto on update scale.  Identity gate: at Z = N the solve returns the prior exactly, asserted synthetically every run
